description: Renames or recolors an existing tag. Pass name, color or both; whichever you omit keeps its current value. The change shows on every monitor that carries the tag. Find the ID with listTags; to add a tag use createTag.

color.description: New tag color as a hex string (e.g. "#ff0000") or CSS color name. Omit to keep the current one.

name.description: New tag name. Omit to keep the current one.

tagID.description: The ID of the tag to update

name: updateTag
title: Update Tag
